name: Special Meeting of The Investment Policy Advisory Committee
agenda_text:
May 29, 2024
3:15
PM
Council Chambers of City Hall
340 Palos Verdes Drive West
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
AGENDA
OF A REGULAR MEETING
OF THE INVESTMENT POLICY ADVISORY COMMITTEE
OF THE CITY OF PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA 90274
Any person having any question concerning any agenda item may call the City Clerk to make an inquiry concerning the item. Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at 310-378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
The Investment Policy Advisory Committee is a new committee, effective July 1, 2017. With the City Treasurer, the Committee shall be responsible for recommending investment brokers, proposing changes to investment policy and practices, presenting investment reports, and evaluating and recommending banking-related matters. Meetings are to review, discuss and develop recommendation on matters such as investment and banking vendors, policy, transactions, returns and performance, brokers, and strategy.
The Investment Policy Advisory Committee, at the direction of the Chairman with concurrence of the Committee, may modify the order of items shown on the agenda.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
This portion of the agenda is reserved for comments from the public on items which are NOT on the agenda. Due to state law, no action can be taken by the Committee this evening on matters presented under this section. If the Committee determines action is warranted, the item may be referred to staff or placed on a future Committee agenda.
OLD BUSINESS
1.
RE-CONFIRM IPAC SCHEDULE TO QUARTERLY, AT 3:00 PM, ON THE WEDNESDAYS THAT FALL CLOSEST TO, BUT NOT LATER THAN, THE 45TH DAY AFTER THE END OF THE QUARTER.
Recommendation: Request that Staff submit a resolution for City Council approval at the earliest possible future meeting to memorialize the new IPAC meeting schedule. Meetings for FY 2024-25 will be as follows:
* August 14, 2024
* November 13, 2024
* February 12, 2025
* May 14, 2025
2.
DEVELOP A PLAN AND SET DATES FOR MEETINGS WITH CURRENT PVE BROKERS OF RECORD
Recommendation: Discuss and recommend content, format and dates for meetings; suggest recommended dates.
NEW BUSINESS
3.
REVIEW INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE 3 MONTHS AND QUARTER ENDED MARCH 31, 2024.
Recommendation: Review, approve and request staff to submit to City Council for approval at the next meeting.
INVESTMENT REPORT
ATTACHMENT A EXHIBIT A
ATTACHMENT B EXHIBIT B
ATTACHMENT C EXHIBIT C
ATTACHMENT D EXHIBIT D
4.
ANNUAL PVE INVESTMENT POLICY REVIEW.
Recommendation: Review and discuss legally required and other proposed changes to the City’s current investment policy. Review and compare the PVE Investment Policies to selected policies from other Cities. Recommend revised version of the Investment Policy for FY 2024-25, and request that Staff submit a resolution for City Council to approve revised version at the next meeting.
INVESTMENT POLICY
ATTACHMENT A
5.
DIVESTITURE OF LOW-YIELD HOLDINGS.
Recommendation: Review and make recommendation regarding sales of certain, older, very low-yield positions a loss to take advantage of the potential to capture higher rates going forward. Evaluate estimated cash impact as well as other implications. Depending on recommendation, develop proposal to take to City Council.
Staff Report
6.
REVISED PROCEDURES TO ENSURE INVESTMENT REPORTS ARE SUBMITTED ON A TIMELY BASIS.
Recommendation: Discuss, Develop and propose changes to current/past practices regarding submission of monthly and quarterly investment reports to Council. Recommend some changes to current/past practice in reporting on cash and investment to avoid missing deadlines. Request suggestions and assistance from staff and submit final recommendations for new procedures to the City Manager.
7.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
* Developing a Charter for the IPAC.
* Developing annual/quarterly cash flow forecasts.
* Revising monthly/quarterly reports to model best practices.
* Compare PVE's portfolio to those of "similar" cities.
ADJOURNMENT TO WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 14, 2024, AT 3:00 P.M.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted on the City Hall Bulletin Boards located by front door located at 340 Palos Verdes Drive West, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274, and on the City's Website (pvestates.org) not less than 24 hours prior to the meeting in accordance with Government Code Section 54956. Dated this 28th day of May 2024. INTERIM CITY CLERK
